I am Legion
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Daimoinon & Obfuscate
Cost: 1 blood
[dai] +1 stealth.
[dai][obf] Cancel a card that requires Auspex [aus] as it is played.
[DAI][OBF] As [dai][obf] above, and/or gain 1 pool if this action is
successful (after resolving the action).

Can I use DAI OBF plus pool effect even if I didnt cancel AUS card? I
guess that part "and/or" says yes, but I want to be sure. Thanks

Messages.Body:

Thats exactly what the "and/or" says. It could not mean anything else.
